limits.description: Current finite Data Mate execution limits for this connection. Optional budgets appear only when enabled.

max_rows.description: Maximum query rows returned. query.row_limit may lower this limit.

max_result_bytes.description: Maximum bytes in the complete MCP tool result for query and metadata tools, including structuredContent, text content and escaping, without the JSON-RPC wrapper.

query_timeout_ms.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds for query and metadata tools, including credential loading, driver admission, connection setup, execution and result reading. Earlier caller and database deadlines still apply.
